## Why

<!-- The problem or the gap. Not a retelling of the diff. -->

## What

<!-- Bullet per change, file-level. Skip for a one-commit PR whose subject already says it. -->

<!-- Commands actually run and their result: `npm test`, `npm run verify`, counts.

## Risk / rollback

<!-- What breaks if this is wrong, and how to undo it (revert commit, flag, manual step).

## Screenshots

<!-- Mandatory for any visual change (.claude/rules/visual-review.md): before / after.
